item.title: Dynamical Breaking of Inversion Symmetry, Strong Second Harmonic Generation, and Nonequilibrium Ferroelectricity with Nonlinear Phonons
item.description:
We show how crystalline inversion symmetry can be dynamically broken by optical phonons with generic, hardening Kerr-like nonlinearities. The symmetry-broken state is reached through a parametric instability that can be accessed by driving close to half the phonon frequency. The system then settles … [Phys. Rev.
